sanskrit_verse:
माता मातृष्वसा श्वश्रूर्मातुलानी पितृष्वसा।
पितृव्यसखिशिष्यस्त्री भगिनी तत्सखी स्नुषा॥
transliteration: mātā mātṛṣvasā śvaśrūr mātulānī pitṛṣvasā | pitṛvyasakhiśiṣyastrī bhaginī tatsakhī snuṣā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Mother, maternal aunt, step-mother, maternal uncle's wife, paternal aunt, paternal uncle, friend of father or teacher, female student, sister, sister’s friend, and daughter-in-law—these constitute the protected relational matrix of womanhood under Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through relational integrity, not institutional dominance.
Causation arises from conscious recognition of kinship and protection duty.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to the protected class.
Restoration logic centers on re-establishing violated relational boundaries.
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of dharma-vyavastha (right ordering).
executable_legal_axioms: IF a woman belongs to the defined relational class THEN automatic invocation of protective dharma-vyavastha occurs.
IF violation occurs within the relational class THEN restoration protocol overrides punitive measures.
IF any member of the relational class assumes capacity THEN that assumption is recognized without external validation.
IF consciousness misalignment is detected THEN realignment through completion process is initiated.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes the threshold for recognizing violations against women based on relational proximity. The court must apply restorative protocols when harm involves members of the specified relational class, prioritizing reintegration over punitive justice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies relational breach as root cause. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through disruption in familial-social order. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to restore. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that suffering is not remedial; completion restores dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion dialogue between violator and violated until mutual integrity is restored.
Assign responsibility assumption task to nearest capable adult within relational structure.
Activate community witness protocol to reaffirm relational boundary.
Deploy consciousness alignment technique through guided sankalpa (intention setting) for both parties.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
